arguments.rule_content:
title: Detect Pass-The-Hash Lateral Movement via SMB
id: d4f5c6e7-1234-5678-9abc-def012345678
status: test
description: |
  Detect SMB authentication attempts using NTLM hash credentials from a non-privileged host to a domain controller.
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: security
detection:
  selection:
    EventID: 4624
    LogonType: 3  # Network logon
    AuthenticationPackageName: NTLM
    WorkstationName|contains: ['10.0.5.']
    TargetServerName: '10.0.8.200'
    ElevatedPriv: true
  condition: selection
fields:
  - SubjectUserName
  - WorkstationName
  - TargetServerName
  - AuthenticationPackageName
  - LogonProcessName
  - LogonType
  - LogonGuid
  - ProcessId
  - IpAddress
  - IpPort
level: high

arguments.rule_content:
title: Detect Named Pipe Impersonation for Privilege Escalation
id: d5c8f9a1-3b2e-4f1a-9c6d-2b7e5f8a9c0d
status: test
description: Detects processes where winlogon.exe spawns cmd.exe via named pipe impersonation, indicating possible privilege escalation.
author: SOC Team
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: security
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\\winlogon.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith: '\\cmd.exe'
    TokenElevationType: 'System'
    PipeName|contains: 'NamedPipe'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child
fields:
  - ParentImage
  - Image
  - TokenElevationType
  - PipeName
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate system maintenance tasks
level: high
